title: 港交所CEO陈翊庭：恒生科技指数调整，更贴近市场
speaker: Bonnie Chan

segments.en: You launched the HKX tech 100 index last year, but less than a year on, you're looking at making some adjustments.
segments.zh: 你们去年推出了恒生科技指数，但不到一年，你们就在考虑调整。

segments.en: Correct. Could you tell us more about these adjustments and why you're making them?
segments.zh: 是的。能告诉我们更多关于这些调整以及为什么做出这些调整吗？

segments.en: Right. Well, first of all, let me tell you about our index business and why we're doing it.
segments.zh: 好的。首先，让我谈谈我们的指数业务以及我们为什么这样做。

segments.en: We certainly think that, as, you know, more focus are turning back to our market, there is a very strong demand from the investors to want to get access to these indices so that, you know, they can have better benchmarking and referencing.
segments.zh: 我们确实认为，随着市场关注度回升，投资者对指数的需求非常强烈，以便更好地进行基准比较和参考。

segments.en: And therefore, first of all, we do believe that Hong Kong as a market certainly will benefit from a bigger variety of indices.
segments.zh: 因此，我们相信香港市场将受益于更多样化的指数。

segments.en: And therefore, given how close we are to the market, we do believe that we are in a very unique position to, to develop our history.
segments.zh: 鉴于我们与市场紧密相连，我们处于独特的位置来发展我们的指数业务。

segments.en: How do you differentiate from the existing benchmarks like the Hong thing, though?
segments.zh: 那么你们与现有基准指数有何不同？

segments.en: Oh, well, it's quite different, I would say.
So the name suggests, the HKX tech 100 index, right?
segments.zh: 正如名称所示，恒生科技指数，对吧？

segments.en: And we deliberately make it in a way so that it's more diverse, which we believe is more representative of the makeup of our market now.
segments.zh: 我们特意使其更加多元化，我们认为这更能代表当前市场的构成。

segments.en: I know you've hit back against this criticism of over-concentration of Chinese companies listing here.
segments.zh: 我知道你反驳了关于中国公司上市过度集中的批评。
